text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The government holds its regular Tuesday meeting. The preliminary agenda includes proposals on further cooperation between Slovakia and the World Bank.
- The Confederation of Trade Unions (KOZ) said it would demand the right to withdraw from this year's collective agreement if the government fails to present a long-term economic strategy.

- Refrigerator producer Calex Zlate Moravce has stopped production until February 17 due to insolvency problems. Calex debts are estimated at some eight billion crowns. The Economics Ministry said the company needs a domestic or foreign strategic partner.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Overall losses in the agricultural sector are expected to total some 2.4 billion crowns in 1996, about 12 percent less than in the previous year.

- Sony's investment in its plant producing TV screens in Trnava, western Slovakia, has so far totalled 190 million crowns. The company said it would invest a further 40 million crowns by the end of the year.

- Slovak Railways, wood processing company Bucina Zvolen and several transport firms have formed a consortium to build a cargo railway terminal in Zvolen, Central Slovakia. The terminal is expected to be directly connected with the Dutch port of Rotterdam.

SME - About 80 percent of Slovaks disagree with the participation of state officials or representatives of the National Property Fund in supervisory bodies of privatised companies, according to a public opinion poll.
- The health care system will require about two billion crowns in 1997, of which one billion should go to wages, the doctor's trade union LOZ said.
